adapter-entry-points.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and clean staged Claude Provider Entry Point generation

governed-dependency-composition.method: Repository contract tests and the production result validator require immutable Registry Lock resolution of portfolio-snapshot and options-vol-analysis, complete dependency-result preservation, options persist=false, and no connector-era substitute

observable-analysis-equivalence.method: Repository tests execute the same digest-bound representative composite result through the production validator for the exact Claude and Codex adapters; the validator rejects changed dependency bytes, false evidence values, missing portfolio/options cross-context observations, persistence, and writes; no live provider invocation is claimed

read-only-authority-boundary.method: Compared the exact Claude adapter with issue #65, accepted parent #46 and blockers #47/#64, the connector-era portfolio-analysis intent, and current Trade Journal and Radon authority boundaries

dependency-unavailability.method: Exact-adapter tests require snapshot failure to stop options invocation and require options refusal, unavailability, or failure to produce a partial zero-write result; current accepted dependency evidence separately covers the eligible portfolio database and options data environments
